Sara Lindqvist
Senior Product Manager
sara.lindqvist@example.com · +1-555-025-2525 · Stockholm, Sweden
Hybrid · Remote · Citizen · Notice period: 30 days
SUMMARY
Sara Lindqvist is a Senior Product Manager with 8.0 years of experience in product strategy, roadmapping,
and data analytics. Based in Stockholm, Sweden, Sara has applied agile methodologies and user testing
across cloud computing and digital media industries. Educational background includes a bachelor degree in
business administration from Stockholm University.
SKILLS
Product Strategy (8 years) · Roadmapping (8 years) · Agile Methodologies (8 years) ·
Market Research (7 years) · Data Analytics (7 years) · User Testing (6 years)
EXPERIENCE
Senior Product Manager — Fjall Cloud Systems Jun 2021 – Present
Industry: Cloud Computing
• Executed Product Strategy and Roadmapping for cloud infrastructure tools.
• Applied Agile Methodologies and Data Analytics in the Cloud Computing industry.
Product Manager — Barken Media Sep 2018 – May 2021
Industry: Digital Media
• Conducted Market Research and User Testing within Digital Media.
• Leveraged Product Strategy and Agile Methodologies to deliver products.
EDUCATION
BSc Business Administration 2018
Stockholm University
LANGUAGES
Swedish (native) · English (C2)
LEADERSHIP
Guided cross-functional product and engineering teams as a Senior Product Manager in the cloud computing
industry.

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Scrum Product Owner · Professional Scrum Master I
